Senses.Note: The closing line of Xuedou's seamless-monument verse says its tiered, rounded image remains available for people to see through all ages; later masters draw, point out, and reuse the line in hall addresses.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T48/T48n2003.xml). Blue Cliff Record by Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo. Xuedou Chongxian utters the exact line in his verse on the seamless monument; Yuanwu Keqin comments on it.

Senses.Explanation: For people to see through age after age closes Xuedou's verse on the seamless monument. Chan records carry the line from verse commentary into hall acts where masters draw or point out the rounded, tiered image and leave it visibly before their assemblies. Xuedou Chongxian supplies the line in the Blue Cliff Record verse and Yuanwu comments on it. Poshan draws a circle with his staff and recites the tiered-shadow couplet; Zishui draws with his staff before the line; Jiqi answers his question about the underlying text with the same duration claim.
